title: The Outer Pressure Problem for the Compressible Navier--Stokes System with Temperature-Dependent Transport Coefficients
summary: We study global strong solutions and their large-time behavior for the one-dimensional outer pressure problem of a viscous, heat-conducting ideal polytropic gas. The viscosity and heat conductivity satisfy $μ=\tildeμθ^α$ and $κ=\tildeκθ^β$. For each prescribed nonnegative pressure and each fixed $β\geq0$, we allow large $H^1$ initial data with positive specific volume and temperature, provided that $α\geq0$ is sufficiently small.
